title: Popular Spring Delicacies
synopsis: Whet your appetite with spring delicacies from around China.

fullText.simplified:
春季美食总动员

    在中国，不同季节吃的食物不同，而且中国南北风俗也不同，每一个地方都有自己独特的美食。今天就带大家看看春季中国不同地区的美食。
    春天的时候，一定要去江西尝一尝春笋。春笋就是竹子的“宝宝”，也就是竹子还是嫩芽的时候。一场春雨过后，去山上挖回春笋，做汤、炒菜都非常鲜美。春笋可以说是大自然给人们最美味的礼物。
    吃完春笋向北走，再去上海感受一下“青团”的味道。用特殊的青草做成的青草汁和面，里边放上馅儿，做成圆圆的球形，再放进锅里蒸熟。甜甜的，带着青草的香味，也许这就是春天的味道吧？
    吃完青团再往北走，去北京尝尝立春的必吃美食“春饼”。用面粉做成薄薄的圆饼，卷上新鲜的蔬菜或者肉，一口咬下去，必须从头吃到尾，代表有始有终，幸福平安。
    除了上边提到的美食，中国春季的美食还有很多很多，等着你去发现哦。说了那么多，你是不是都有点饿了？哈哈，你的家乡有什么春天的美食呢？说出来一起分享一下吧！
fullText.traditional:
春季美食總動員

    在中國，不同季節吃的食物不同，而且中國南北風俗也不同，每一個地方都有自己獨特的美食。今天就帶大家看看春季中國不同地區的美食。
    春天的時候，一定要去江西嘗一嘗春筍。春筍就是竹子的“寶寶”，也就是竹子還是嫩芽的時候。一場春雨過後，去山上挖回春筍，做湯、炒菜都非常鮮美。春筍可以說是大自然給人們最美味的禮物。
    吃完春筍向北走，再去上海感受一下“青團”的味道。用特殊的青草做成的青草汁和麵，裡邊放上餡兒，做成圓圓的球形，再放進鍋裡蒸熟。甜甜的，帶著青草的香味，也許這就是春天的味道吧？
    吃完青團再往北走，去北京嘗嘗立春的必吃美食“春餅”。用麵粉做成薄薄的圓餅，卷上新鮮的蔬菜或者肉，一口咬下去，必須從頭吃到尾，代表有始有終，幸福平安。
    除了上邊提到的美食，中國春季的美食還有很多很多，等著你去發現哦。說了那麼多，你是不是都有點餓了？哈哈，你的家鄉有什麼春天的美食呢？說出來一起分享一下吧！

sentences.english: Every place has its own unique delicacies.
Today, we’ll take a look at spring delicacies from different parts of China.

sentences.english: Spring bamboo shoots are “baby” bamboo shoots, which means the bamboo shoots are still at the soft stage.

sentences.traditional: 春筍可以說是大自然給人們最美味的禮物。

Spring bamboo shoots can be described as the most delicious gift that nature has given to mankind.

sentences.pinyin: yòng tè shū de qīng cǎo zuò chéng de qīng cǎo zhī huò miàn
sentences.english: After trying spring bamboo shoots, head north to Shanghai to experience the flavor of “qingtuan”.

It has the sweet aroma of grass. Perhaps this is the flavor of spring?

sentences.traditional: 用麵粉做成薄薄的圓餅，卷上新鮮的蔬菜或者肉，

raw.synopsis: Whet your appetite with spring delicacies from around China.
sentence_translations: In China, different food is eaten during different seasons, and customs in the north and south are also different.
Every place has its own unique delicacies.
Today, we’ll take a look at spring delicacies from different parts of China.
In spring, you must go to Jiangxi to try spring bamboo shoots.
Spring bamboo shoots are “baby” bamboo shoots, which means the bamboo shoots are still at the soft stage.
After a spring rain, go into the mountains to dig bamboo shoots. They are extremely delicious in soups and stir-fries.
Spring bamboo shoots can be described as the most delicious gift that nature has given to mankind.
After trying spring bamboo shoots, head north to Shanghai to experience the flavor of “qingtuan”.
Grass juice, which is made from a special grass, is used to knead the flour.
It is stuffed with fillings, made into a spherical shape, then placed in a pot to steam until cooked.
It has the sweet aroma of grass. Perhaps this is the flavor of spring?
After trying qingtuan, head north again, ..
.. and go to Beijing to try the must-eat delicacy at the start of spring, “spring pancakes”.
The thin pancakes are made from flour and have fresh vegetables or meat wrapped inside.
If you take a bite, you must finish it all to symbolize “finishing what one starts” and “peace and happiness.”
Apart from the delicacies mentioned above, there are many other Chinese spring delicacies waiting for you to discover.
Do you feel a bit hungry after all this? Haha, what spring delicacies are there in your hometown? Share them with us!
